verdict_statement: BOTH representation boundaries are mismatched.  (D51-A) the generated clean Dice thresholds the LIVE float32 final probability while the frozen Phase27 bound CSV thresholds the PERSISTED float16 final probability; (D51-B) the frozen v1.14 G reproduction gate proves only float16 equality of the GLOBAL probability, while the downstream clean path consumes the LIVE float32 global probability, so the gate does not prove equality of the downstream input.

d51_a.label: D51-A: FINAL_SCORE_REPRESENTATION_MISMATCH
d51_a.statement: Phase27 Phase B computed the authoritative final_dice from the persisted float16 final-probability cache recast to float32; the v1.14/v1.2 generated clean path computes final_dice from the live float32 final probability.

generated_side.expression: final_prob = np.asarray(out['final_probability'], dtype=np.float32); final_binary = (final_prob >= SEGMENTATION_OUTPUT_THRESHOLD).astype(np.float32); dice = _dice(final_binary, gt)

bound_side.expression: gp = np.load(CACHE27/'phase27_val808_global_prob_f16.npy'); fp = np.load(CACHE27/'phase27_val808_final_prob_f16.npy'); f_bin = (np.asarray(fp[i], dtype=np.float32) >= SEG).astype(np.uint8); f_dice = canon_dice(f_bin, gt_bin)  # SEG = 0.50

d51_a.threshold_location: float16 reloaded and cast to float32 before threshold 0.50
d51_a.note: Phase A's docstring claim 'Binary decisions are taken in float32 BEFORE any float16 storage cast' applies ONLY to the Phase A visualization mask PNGs (run_phase27_exec_phaseA.py L298/L382), NOT to the authoritative scored final_dice, which is computed in Phase B from the f16 cache.

d51_b.label: D51-B: G_REPRODUCTION_GATE_REPRESENTATION_TOO_WEAK_FOR_DOWNSTREAM
d51_b.statement: The v1.14 G reproduction gate compares ONLY the float16 global-probability cache (np.array_equal on f16).  The downstream clean path consumes the live float32 global probability (ROI geometry, 202-D features, refiner crop, S_omega features).  The gate therefore does NOT constrain the downstream input representation.

downstream_consumes.expression: p_global = np.asarray(out['probability'][bi], dtype=np.float32); p_f16[idx_of[sid]] = p_global.astype(np.float16); p_global = generated['p_global'][sid]  # LIVE float32

phase27_downstream_representation.expression: p_global = prob[i].astype(np.float32); geom = roi_geometry(p_global, E.ROI_PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD); feats202 = build_feature_vector(cmaps, p_global, geom); prob_crop = crop_and_resize_vec(p_global, geom, REGIONAL_INPUT_RESOLUTION); p_final = fuse_full_field(p_global, refined, geom)

d51_b.consequence: Both Phase27 and Phase36 downstream consume the live float32 G, but Phase27's live float32 G was NEVER persisted (only the float16 cache).  A float32 G authority therefore does not exist, so the f16 gate cannot prove equality of the downstream input.  f16-equal but f32-different global probability passes the gate and can still diverge downstream.

prediction_hash_barrier_ordering.statement: predictions CSV hashed (L421), masks and both prob caches hashed (L427-428), sidecar written with hashed_before_gt_read=True and gt_reads_at_hash_time=0 (L445-446).  Phase B re-verifies the hashes BEFORE reading GT (run_phase27_exec_phaseB.py L106-118).

gt_first_read_site.note: Phase A performs zero GT reads (val808_gt_reads=0).

not_used: phase27_val808_global_prob_f16.npy (option B) is NOT consumed downstream
the f16 cache re-cast to float32 (option C) is NOT consumed downstream
section_b_phase27_downstream_g_represent.asymmetry: Phase27 downstream = live float32 G; Phase27 authoritative final_dice = persisted float16 final probability.  The two boundaries differ.

classification_rationale: D51-A is proven by source: the two Dice computations threshold different representations.
D51-B is proven by source: the G gate compares f16 only while the downstream consumes live f32; no float32 G authority exists.

D51-A ALONE is insufficient: the GT-free worst-case Dice deviation reachable by flipping every boundary pixel is bounded (see d51a_bound), yet observed deviations reach the max_abs_dice_deviation; 128 rows lie outside their own reachable D51-A interval and 6 rows have ZERO boundary pixels (D51-A contributes exactly 0 there).
NOT CLAIMED: that one mechanism explains all 390 rows.  D51-A is sufficient for at most (n_mismatch - n_not_explainable) rows; the remainder require a second boundary.

section_d_repair_design.principle: clean equivalence must compare the new clean prediction against the frozen Phase27 prediction at the SAME numerical representation boundary; the only frozen, recoverable boundary is the persisted float16 cache.

specification.generated_representation_to_compare: the generated clean FINAL probability field out['final_probability'] from canonical_learned_core, cast float32 -> float16, i.e. the exact analogue of the frozen Phase27 final_prob_f16 cache
specification.dtype: float16 (comparison in f16; float16 -> float32 recast is exact and lossless)
specification.threshold_location: threshold applied to the SAME f16 representation on BOTH sides: (f16_value.astype(np.float32) >= 0.50); equivalently (f16_value >= np.float16(0.50)) since 0.5 is exactly representable
specification.final_probability_bit_identity_required: REQUIRED as a separately-reported primary check (mirroring the G gate's BIT_IDENTICAL_FLOAT16_PERSISTED_GLOBAL_PROBABILITY).  The Dice comparison still proceeds on the common f16 representation; a Dice match with a NON-identical probability cache is flagged, never silently accepted.
specification.fallback_diagnostic_if_non_identical: record max_abs, mismatch_count, affected sample IDs and affected batch IDs, and STOP before any downstream perturbation execution (mirrors the G gate's stop_before_downstream_perturbation); silent acceptance FORBIDDEN.
specification.dice_derivation_after_common_representat: generated: gen_f16 = np.asarray(out['final_probability'], dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float16); gen_bin = (gen_f16.astype(np.float32) >= 0.50).astype(np.uint8); gen_dice = dice(binary_confusion_counts(gen_bin, gt)).  bound: the frozen Phase27 CSV final_dice is UNCHANGED (it already uses this representation).
specification.g_handoff_boundary_repair: strengthen the G gate from f16-only to a downstream-input-relevant proof.  Because Phase27's live float32 G was never persisted, the downstream input boundary must be re-pinned to the frozen f16 authority: the generated f32 G is cast to f16 and recast to f32 (exact) before ROI/202-D/refiner/S_omega, so the downstream input is bit-reproducible and identical to the frozen authority.  Optionally persist a float32 G authority going forward so the downstream input can be compared at f32.
specification.phase36_perturbation_metric_path: YES — the perturbation path (_dice(pert_binary, gt), run_image_perturbations / run_proposal_perturbations) must use the SAME f16 persistence boundary for its final probability before thresholding; otherwise clean-vs-perturbed comparisons mix representations.  This is required for internal consistency of the DeltaDice estimand.

smallest_additive_shape: 1. cast the generated clean final probability to float16 before thresholding (align to the frozen authority).
2. add a final-probability f16 bit-identity check against phase27_val808_final_prob_f16.npy (reported, fail-loud).
3. align the downstream G input to the frozen f16 authority (f32 -> f16 -> f32) so the downstream input is bit-reproducible.
4. apply the same f16 persistence boundary to the perturbation final probabilities.
NO change to any threshold, comparator, GT construction, or metric definition.
